attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The refactor changes the actual query/ordering logic for taxonomy term item listing (adding TaxonomyIndex.Id as a secondary sort and restructuring the With/ThenBy chain) while moving core models/index into a new assembly, so a subtle mistake in paging or type resolution could break front-end taxonomy term listings across all sites even though the public namespaces are preserved."}

reason: The refactor changes the actual query/ordering logic for taxonomy term item listing (adding TaxonomyIndex.Id as a secondary sort and restructuring the With/ThenBy chain) while moving core models/index into a new assembly, so a subtle mistake in paging or type resolution could break front-end taxonomy term listings across all sites even though the public namespaces are preserved.
